name: AI SaaS Backend - Content Generation + Stripe Billing

parameters.content:
## AI SaaS Backend (Content Generation + Stripe Billing)

A single n8n workflow that acts as the backend for an AI content-generation SaaS. A client app POSTs an API key + generation request to the webhook. n8n resolves the API key to a Stripe customer, checks the customer has an active subscription and hasn't exceeded their plan's usage limit, calls Claude to generate text or image content, records a Stripe usage record against the customer's metered subscription item, and returns the generated content (or a clear error) to the caller synchronously.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: Stripe API, Anthropic API (header auth, x-api-key)
3. Edit Set - Config: stripeUsagePriceId (the metered Price your subscription item uses), anthropicModel, planLimits (JSON map of Stripe price/plan id -> monthly generation limit), imageGenEndpoint (if using an external image API instead of Claude)
4. Point your app's API-key lookup at Stripe Customer metadata (this workflow expects customer.metadata.apiKey to match the incoming key) or swap in your own key store
5. Activate the workflow; the webhook URL is your API endpoint

### Requirements
- Stripe API access (customers, subscriptions, subscription items, usage records)
- Anthropic API access (Claude) for text generation; an image API for image generation

### How to customize
- Swap the API-key -> customer lookup for a dedicated auth/DB service if you don't want to store keys in Stripe metadata
- Replace the in-memory-per-run usage check with a real usage table (Postgres/Airtable) if you need cross-run accuracy beyond Stripe's own metered usage
- Add a queue (instead of synchronous webhook response) for slow image generations
- Extend planLimits per price id as you add new pricing tiers

## 1. Trigger, Config & Auth

Webhook - Generation Request receives the client's request: apiKey, contentType (text|image), prompt, and optional params.

Set - Config centralizes the Stripe metered price id, Anthropic model, and per-plan usage limits.

HTTP Request - Stripe: Find Customer By API Key searches Stripe customers for metadata.apiKey matching the incoming key.

IF - Customer Found routes unknown keys straight to an Unauthorized response, and known keys onward to the subscription check.

## 2. Subscription & Usage Entitlement

HTTP Request - Stripe: Get Active Subscription fetches the customer's subscription and its metered subscription item.

HTTP Request - Stripe: Get Current Period Usage pulls the usage record summary for the current billing period on that subscription item.

JS - Check Entitlement compares subscription status + current usage against the plan's limit (from Set - Config planLimits) and decides allow/block, carrying a clear reason either way.

IF - Entitlement OK routes blocked requests to a 402/403-style error response, and allowed requests onward to generation.

## 3. AI Content Generation

Switch - Content Type routes to text or image generation based on the request.

HTTP Request - Claude: Generate Text Content calls the Anthropic API for text generation.

HTTP Request - Generate Image Content calls your configured image generation endpoint.

Merge - Combine Generation Results brings both branches back together with a consistent shape for the response/billing steps.

## 4. Usage Recording, Billing & Response

HTTP Request - Stripe: Record Usage posts a usage record (quantity 1, action increment) to the customer's metered subscription item so Stripe bills correctly at period end.

JS - Build Success Response shapes the final payload (generated content, usage remaining, request id).

Respond - Success returns 200 with the generated content.

The Unauthorized and Entitlement-blocked branches from earlier steps each end in their own Respond node (401 / 402) so the client always gets a clear, synchronous answer.
